title: AlmaLinux OS 9 must not have the gssproxy package installed.
check_content:
Verify that the gssproxy package is not installed with the following command:

Note: If NFS mounts are authorized and in use on the system, this is not applicable.

$ dnf list --installed gssproxy

Error: No matching Packages to list

If the "gssproxy" package is installed and is not documented with the information system security officer (ISSO) as an operational requirement, this is a finding.
fixtext:
Remove the gssproxy package with the following command:

$ dnf remove gssproxy
VulnDiscussion: The gssproxy package is a proxy for GSS API credential handling and could expose secrets on some networks. It is not needed for normal function of the OS.
